info.name: NestJS Authentication Foundation - Phases 1-5
info.description: Complete implemented API collection. Read docs/WORKING-GUIDE.md first. Configure password/resetPassword/newPassword locally; no credentials or tokens are shipped. The collection works without an environment; an optional Local environment is supplied for input overrides. Runtime bearer/CSRF/session variables are stored at collection scope, while the Postman cookie jar holds refresh cookies. Mail tokens are intentionally obtained outside HTTP responses. Do not Run All blindly: verification/recovery require a mail-token checkpoint and some requests revoke sessions. The Health folder is directly runnable. After password change/reset, password is updated for the next Login. Scripts never print secrets. Clear sensitive local state before exporting or sharing. Phase 5 management requests require explicit operator bootstrap of an existing active verified account. New catalog permissions grant nothing automatically. Management variables must target disposable identities/roles deliberately. See docs/phase-05.md. Includes user/company CRUD with shared repositories, verified-account provisioning and safe archival. Unified frontend: http://localhost:3001/login. Admin Login additionally requires admin.access. Run npm run db:seed for an explicit development admin; passwords remain local Postman inputs. CRM endpoints include reference-style profiles, guard-aware roles, filtered exports, atomic bulk archival/restoration, and email login-code verification. See docs/CRM-MANAGEMENT.md.

item.name: 09 - Authorization and administration
item.description: Authenticate and bootstrap the actor through authorization:bootstrap first. These are privileged, stateful requests; do not Run All. New permission definitions grant nobody authority until a trusted operator authorizes the first grant. Set targetUserId deliberately; scripts never auto-select your current account for suspension. Names are immutable after role creation.

item.name: CRM Management
item.description: Run deliberately on disposable records. Admins require admins.* independently. Bulk operations are atomic. Deletion archives accounts/companies; roles are permanently deleted. CSV/XLSX require read + export permissions. Start mail worker for verification and email login codes.
